messages:
zane: quick heads-up — onboarding aegis-v2-q8 (quant bring-up) shows a strange collapse for mixed vertical-CJK + RTL inputs in the translation eval set. reproducer below, low noise but consistent on long contexts. :eyes:
anya: can you paste a tiny failing example?
zane: here — input is a mixed layout with ruby/vertical markers and an arabic clause. when run through the q8 model we get truncated punctuation and mirrored brackets flipped inside the RTL span. small example:```
INPUT: 　｜漢字《訳》
ARABIC: السلام (السلام)
PROMPT: translate to en preserving layout

FP16_OUT:
"The text ｜漢字《訳》 — السلام (as-salaam)"

Q8_OUT:
"The text ｜漢字 — 訳》 السلام )as-salaam("
```
li-wei: hmm those outputs look like token boundary shifts plus bracket mirroring gone wrong. is this only on long context or even short?
marta: any metric numbers? BLEU / chrF on the failing subset?
zane: quick stats from the vertical-bidi slice (n=220): fp16 baseline BLEU=31.8 chrF=54.1; aegis-v2-q8 BLEU=25.9 chrF=47.6. severe on samples with >512 tokens. for short <128, delta is small (~0.6 BLEU).
eval-bot: run 5491 created: aegis-v2-q8 onboard smoke — https://redwood-evals/5491 — shows BLEU drop 5.9 on vertical-bidi subset (tag: onboard/q8)
anya: could be a kernel selection issue — q8 path picked a new bidi-aware kernel last week. @li-wei did we change kernel fallback policy in runtime? :thinking:
li-wei: we did tweak kernel heuristics (PR #4123) to prefer fused attention for long prefix patterns; maybe fusion combined with prefix-kv caching produces shuffled token indices for mixed-direction segments. I'll bisect.
zane: reproduce notes: single-rep script `scripts/repro/vertical_bidi_repro.py` runs in ~30s, uses continuous batching with prefix caching enabled by default. disabling prefix cache makes outputs match fp16. so it's definitely cache/streaming interaction.
marta: interesting — that implies stateful KV handling + quant kernel mismatch. can you paste the token id diff? small excerpt is fine.
zane: token diffs (chars -> token ids):```
INPUT: ｜ 漢 字 《 訳 》  
FP16 TOKENS: [1542, 7845, 301, 78, 9001, 78, 2]
Q8 TOKENS:   [1542, 7845, 301, 78, 9001, 9001, 2]  # extra 9001 where closing quote should be token 78
```
anya: aha extra 9001 indicates tokenmap aliasing (merge) — maybe quantized embedding table row collapse for those punctuation subtokens. could be quant rounding combined with mixed-orientation byte merges.
li-wei: plan: 1) reproduce locally with `--no-prefix-cache` and `--kernel=fallback` to confirm, 2) run diff of embedding L2 norms between fp16 and q8 for the punctuation tokens, 3) run a kernel-bisect to see when token map changed. I'll take bisect.
marta: I'll add a golden sample to the onboard smoke suite and pin it to the aegis-v2-q8 canary so we catch regressions early. test name: `multilang/vertical_bidi_token_stability.json` run_id=5491-smoke.
zane: thanks. I'll attach model shard + reproducer + eval csv to the ticket. Also flagging as P1 for onboarding since this alters user-visible text. :facepalm:
anya: can we also try a quick remap in the detok stage as a temporary mitigation? e.g., normalize fullwidth punct before detok. if that reduces user impact we can ship a hotfix.
li-wei: noted. I'll push a kernel fallback patch to the q8 runtime branch and run a full smoke; if it fixes we can ship a short-lived override. assigning myself to INF-1287.
eval-bot: ticket INF-1287 opened: "Aegis-v2-q8: token collapse on mixed vertical-CJK + RTL (KV-cache/kernel interaction)" — https://redwood-issues/INF-1287 :ticket:
zane: great. cc @anya @marta. leaving reproducer and eval link in the ticket. will update once I have the L2 diff and a minimal bisect point.
